name: Japan 1944 (Marianas)
description:
The Japanese garrison of the Marianas in mid-1944: the 43rd Division on Saipan, the 29th on Guam, and the anti-aircraft belt that made Aslito and Orote expensive.

Every ground and air-defense unit is a real Japanese type. The two aircraft are not: DCS ships no Japanese airframe, so the I-16 stands in for the A6M and the Fw 190 A-8 for the heavier Army fighters, both wearing the IJN liveries DCS ships for exactly this purpose. Field artillery is a German towed stand-in for the same reason.

No navy. The IJN carrier force was destroyed at the Philippine Sea on 19-20 June 1944, and DCS ships no IJN hull.
